extracted.name: Lemony Cream of Chicken Soup
extracted.description: This creamy lemon chicken rice soup is a simple 5-ingredient recipe with condensed soup and broth that has plenty of lemony flavors for a quick meal.
ingredient_lines: 2 (26 ounce) cans cream of chicken soup
0.75 cup lemon juice, or to taste
instruction_lines: Combine broth and chicken chunks in a large pot; bring to a boil. Add rice; simmer until rice is tender, 15 to 20 minutes.
Stir in condensed soup and lemon juice. Cook, stirring occasionally, until soup is hot, 5 to 10 minutes.
